mu_name_from: Noria's object slot 41, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object4/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under an nr_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing for the reason the ground's is: assets/textures is one flat pool for every world, and yellow_jewel.png was already taken by an item.
material_note: u2u3: black, with one soft blue streak in its upper half. The black adds nothing; the streak is what runs round the rings.
why_this_one: Object40, Object41, Object42 and Object43 are one thing: all four stand at 18100,10450, a few units apart in height, and together they are the Chaos Machine beside the Chaos Goblin. This is the rings over it.
additive_from: ZzzObject.cpp, MoveObject, case WD_3NORIA: `o->BlendMesh = 0` for type 41, every frame. Drawn solid it was three black hoops with a blue line painted on, which is what the black of an additive sheet looks like when nothing adds it.
glow_from: The same case: `o->BlendMeshTexCoordV = (int)WorldTime % 2000 * 0.0005f`, a sawtooth from 0 up to 1 every two seconds. Half a repetition a second, and positive where Lorencia's water is negative - so -0.5 here, because scrolls_per_second counts MU's usual -(WorldTime % period) direction as forward. The blue streak travels round the rings rather than sitting on them.
